caption: The video captures a snow-laden outdoor deck framed by tall pine trees against a clear blue sky, with a stainless grill at the far left and a wooden railing running across the middle. A round metal table and three metal chairs sit in the foreground, each topped with a rounded cap of snow, while a deep snowbank fills the lower frame. Over the course of the clip the white dome on the tabletop slowly recedes, flattening and shrinking until a smaller residual patch leaves the dark surface partly exposed. The snow caps on the chair seats likewise thin out, losing their rounded bulk. The lighting remains largely consistent, though shadows shift as a darker shadowed area creeps into the lower-left corner. The camera viewpoint and the background trees remain essentially fixed throughout.
relations: As time passes, the snow dome on the metal table flattens and shrinks, exposing the dark surface.
The snow caps on the chair seats thin out and lose their rounded bulk during the clip.
A darker shadow creeps into the lower-left corner while the overall lighting remains consistent.
The camera viewpoint and background trees remain fixed as the foreground snow undergoes visible change.
